43177.subject: Economics
43177.question_text:
The mean of the following scores

30, 32, 34, 36, 38, 40 and 42

What is the mean deviation?
43177.explanation:
30, 32, 34, 36, 38, 40, 42 = 7 terms

Assumed mean = \(\frac{30 + 32 + 34 + 36 + 38 + 40 + 42}{7}\)

\(\frac{252}{7}\) = 36

Next we minus each value from the mean (36). Hence we have;

x      x -  \(\mu\)  x - \(\mu\)
30      -6      6
32      -4     4
34      -2     2
36       0     0
38       2     2
40      4      4
42      6      6
Total         24

M.D  = \(\sum\) \(\frac{|x - \mu |}{N}\)  = \(\frac{24}{7}\) = 3.42
